notes.title: Next Beta Test Oct. 11th
notes.content:
[p]Yes that's right, we'll be back with another public beta weekend for more playtesting! We've listened to your feedback and made some significant adjustments to the core gameplay, including [b]adjusting the map layout and removing the Safe Zone mechanic[/b]. We are also in the process of redoing our maps! This work is in progress so some of the maps will still use the old style during the playtest. Check out our new Viking arena map here![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45644708/384f5433638624cb876deea55b208a407c7af2d0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] Some differences from our last test:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]We'll be starting players with a bunch of currency so they can test more of the game's cards.[/p][/*][*][p]We'll be doing a full weekend this time, so both Saturday and Sunday will be open.
[/p][/*][/list][p]We'll be resetting all player accounts beforehand as usual. The team has been hard at work making many upgrades to the game and we're excited to run another test! Join us on Discord for up to date information on the playtest as it happens. Sign-ups are open now![/p]

notes.title: Next Beta Test on Sept. 6th
notes.content: [p]We will be opening the game for a second free beta test on Saturday, September 6th! The test will be only 1 day this time. We received a lot of encouragement, feature requests and critical feedback from the first test. The dev team is working overtime to address as much as possible before the next test. Please keep in mind the following notes for the next beta test:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]We will invite many more new players![/p][/*][*][p]Previously allowed players will also be able to play again during the 1 day testing period.[/p][/*][*][p]All player account data will be wiped and reset before the test. Account data will be wiped after the test too (nothing carries over to live).[/p][/*][*][p]Kaiju Crab has been nerfed cry (there are actually many balance changes from the previous test, we look forward to players finding new broken combos!) [/p][/*][/list][p]There is still time to sign up for the next test on our Steam page. Please refer to our previous post for more details on expectations and features for beta testing. We hope to see you there![/p]

notes.title: Free Beta Weekend Details
notes.content: [p]Beta weekend is starting in just a few days! We have a lot of signups and are very excited to show a larger group of players the new game for the very first time. We wanted to break down some details of how the beta test will work:[/p][p][/p][h1][b]TESTING SCHEDULE[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Playtesting will be [b]multiplayer focused[/b], with only a short section of the Campaign available for tutorial mechanics. Queues will be open, along with custom lobbies and practice mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Invites will be sent to a random selection of signed up players.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Beta will open at 12am EST on Saturday, August 23rd[/b]. The first wave of invites will head out around this time.[/p][/*][*][p]Saturday night, the dev team may elect to send out a second wave of invites.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Servers will close on Sunday night[/b] EST and the playtest will end (exact time tbd).[/p][/*][*][p]There will be a community Draft event hosted by a streamer on Saturday at 3pm PST, which anyone can join. (I apologize if the servers explode)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]GIVING FEEDBACK[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Please fill in the [b]feedback form[/b] after you're done playing! There is a [b]big shiny button right on the main menu[/b] that takes you directly to the feedback form. Tell us what you think of the game, both good and bad. We will read every single entry to make sure we're on the right track and look for opportunities to improve the game.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]STAYING UP TO DATE[/b][/h1][p]Discord will be the primary dev communication tool for up to the minute status and such. Join our Discord to find out when invites have gone up, if servers have crashed, that sort of thing.[/p][p][/p][p]We will also have a [b]BUG REPORT CHANNEL[/b] on [b]DISCORD[/b]. As beta testers, you should expect to potentially encounter some bugs. Please report them in the channel![/p][p][/p][p]That should be it. We hope to see you in the beta test in a few days![/p]

notes.title: Beta Test Signups!
notes.content: [p]Good news everyone! We're having a public beta test the weekend of August 23rd! Our newest Cards and Castles game is absolutely awesome, and has crazy new features like free drafts, ranked wagers, graveyards, a single player story campaign and more. You can Request Access to the playtest on our store page right here. Beta invites will be by random selection.[/p]

notes.title: Closed Beta Coming Soon!
notes.content: [p]Closed beta is imminent! Follow this page to be notified when playtest signups become available.[/p]
